Yǔ Yì raised a large army,
planning to attack Shí Jìlóng,
and held sole control of the upper reaches of the river,
causing the imperial court to fear him.
In the first month, on the day Rénwǔ, of the first year of Kāngdì Jiànyuán,
Táibái entered Mǎo.
The prognostication stated:
"There will be war in the land of Zhào."
It also stated:
"War will break out throughout the realm."
In the fourth month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
Táibái was visible during the day.
In this year,
Shí Jìlóng killed his son Suì.
He also dispatched generals to raid and seize Dídào,
and garrisoned troops east of Jì,
planning to attack Mùróng Huàng.
In the second year,
Suìxīng (Jupiter) encroached upon Tiānguān (Zeta Tauri).
Ānxī Jiāngjūn Yǔ Yì wrote to his elder brother Bīng, saying:
"Suìxīng encroached upon Tiānguān.
The prognostication states, 'Passes and bridges will be divided.'
Lately, there have been no other incidents in Jiāngdōng,
and the route along the river has not been difficult.
Yet Shí Jìlóng has closed the passes twice in consecutive years,
and has not allowed envoys to pass.
This is further evidence of Heaven's confusion,
a sign of indistinct right and wrong."
In the intercalary month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
Táibái encroached upon Dǒu.
The prognostication stated:
"It signifies mourning,
and the bestowal of titles and emoluments throughout the realm."
In the ninth month,
the Emperor passed away.
The Crown Prince was enthroned,
a general amnesty was declared,
and titles were bestowed.
In the first year of Yǒnghé (永和) of Emperor Mù (穆帝), in the first month, on the day Dīngchǒu (丁丑),
the moon entered Bì (畢).
The prognostication stated:
"A great war will arise."
On the day Wùyín (戊寅),
the moon infringed upon Tiānguān (天關).
The prognostication stated:
"There will be a rebellious minister who changes the emperor's laws."
In the fifth month, on the day Xīnsì (辛巳),
Tài Bái (太白) was seen in daylight,
in Dōngjǐng (東井).
The prognostication stated:
"Ministers will be powerful,
and Qín (秦) will have troops."
In the sixth month, on the day Xīnchǒu (辛丑),
the moon entered Tàiwēi (太微),
infringing upon the southwestern star of Píng (屏).
The prognostication stated:
"An assisting minister will be dismissed or relieved of duty."
In the seventh and eighth months,
the moon both infringed upon Bì (畢).
The prognostication was the same as above.
On the day Jǐwèi (己未),
the moon infringed upon Yúguǐ (輿鬼).
The prognostication stated:
"A high minister will be executed."
In the ninth month, on the day Gēngxū (庚戌),
the moon again infringed upon Bì (畢).
At the beginning of this year,
Yǔ Yì (庾翼) was in Xiāngyáng (襄陽).
In the seventh month,
Yì (翼) was gravely ill and about to die.
He arbitrarily appointed his son Yuánzhī (爰之) as the Inspector of Jīngzhōu (荊州),
to succeed him.
Yuánzhī (爰之) was soon deposed.
The following year,
Huán Wēn (桓溫) again arbitrarily led his troops to attack Shǔ (蜀),
captured Lǐ Shì (李勢),
and sent him to the capital.
Shǔ (蜀) was originally Qín (秦) territory.
In the second year, in the second month, on the day Rénzǐ (壬子),
the moon infringed upon the upper stars of Fáng (房).
In the fourth month, on the day Bǐngxū (丙戌),
the moon again infringed upon the upper stars of Fáng (房).
In the eighth month, on the day Rénshēn (壬申),
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Zuǒ Zhífǎ (左執法).
In the third year, in the first month, on the day Rénwǔ (壬午),
the moon infringed upon the fifth star of Nándǒu (南斗).
The prognostication stated:
"A general will die,
and a close minister will leave."
In the fifth month, on the day Rénshēn (壬申),
the moon infringed upon the fourth star of Nándǒu (南斗),
and then entered Kuí (魁).
The prognostication stated:
"There will be war."
One interpretation said:
"There will be a great amnesty."
In the sixth month,
the moon infringed upon the Jù (距) star of Dōngjǐng (東井).
The prognostication stated:
"A general will die,
and the country will have sorrow."
On the day Wùxū (戊戌),
the moon infringed upon Wǔzhūhóu (五諸侯).
The prognostication stated:
"There will be executions among the feudal lords."
In the ninth month, on the day Gēngyín (庚寅),
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon the fifth star of Nándǒu (南斗).
The prognostication stated:
"It means mourning,
and it means war."
In the fourth year, in the seventh month, on the day Bǐngshēn (丙申),
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Zuǒ Zhífǎ (左執法).
On the day Jiǎyín (甲寅),
the moon infringed upon Fáng (房).
On the day Dīngsì (丁巳),
the moon entered Nándǒu (南斗),
infringing upon the second star.
On the day Yǐchǒu (乙丑),
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Zuǒ Zhífǎ (左執法).
All prognostication were the same as above.
In the tenth month, on the day Jiǎchén (甲辰),
the moon infringed upon Kàng (亢).
The prognostication stated:
"War will arise,
and a general will die."
In the eleventh month, on the day Wùxū (戊戌),
the moon infringed upon the Shàngjiāng (上將) star.
In the sixth month of the third year,
there was a great amnesty.
In this month,
Chén Kuí (陳逵) campaigned against Shòuchūn (壽春),
but was defeated and returned.
In the seventh month,
the remaining bandits of Dī (氐) and Shǔ (蜀) rebelled,
disturbing Yìtǔ (益土).
In the ninth month,
Shí Jìlóng (石季龍) attacked Liángzhōu (涼州).
In the fifth year,
General-in-chief Who Conquers the North Chǔ Póu (褚裒) died.
In the fourth year, in the fourth month,
Tài Bái (太白) entered Mǎo (昴).
At this time,
the barbarians (Róng 戎) and the Jìn (晉) mutually invaded,
and the Zhaò (趙) region was particularly plagued by continuous warfare.
In the seventh month,
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Xuānyuán (軒轅).
The prognostication stated:
"It concerns Zhaò (趙),
and means war and mourning."
On the day Jiǎyín (甲寅),
the moon infringed upon Fáng (房).
In the tenth month, on the day Jiǎxū (甲戌),
the moon infringed upon Kàng (亢).
The prognostication stated:
"War will arise,
and a general will die."
In the eighth month,
Shí Jìlóng’s (石季龍) crown prince Xuān (宣) killed his younger brother Tāo (韜),
and Xuān (宣) also died.
In the eleventh month of that year, on the day Wùxū (戊戌),
the moon infringed upon the Shàngjiāng (上將) star.
In the first month of the fifth year,
Shí Jìlóng (石季龍) usurped the title of emperor,
and soon died.
In the fifth year, in the fourth month, on the day Dīngwèi (丁未),
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Dōngjǐng (東井).
The prognostication stated:
"Qín (秦) will have troops."
In the ninth month, on the day Wùxū (戊戌),
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Zuǒjiǎo (左角).
The prognostication stated:
"It means war."
In the tenth month,
the moon infringed upon Mǎo (昴).
The prognostication stated:
"The Hú (胡) will have sorrow,
and a general will die."
In the eighth month of this year,
Chǔ Póu’s (褚裒) northern campaign was defeated.
In the tenth month,
more than twenty fortresses in Guānzhōng (關中) raised troops and submitted.
Shí Zūn (石遵) attacked and captured Nányáng (南陽).
In the eleventh month,
Rǎn Mǐn (冉閔) killed Shí Zūn (石遵),
and also slaughtered over 100,000 Hú (胡) people,
whereupon Zhaò (趙) and Wèi (魏) fell into great chaos.
In the twelfth month,
Chǔ Póu (褚裒) died.
In the eighth year,
Liú Xiǎn (劉顯), Fú Jiàn (苻健), and Mùróng Jùn (慕容儁) all usurped titles.
Yīn Hào (殷浩) launched a northern expedition,
suffered a defeat,
and was deposed.
In the sixth year, in the second month, on the day Xīnyǒu (辛酉),
the moon infringed upon Xīn Dà (心大) star.
The prognostication stated:
"A great person will have sorrow,
and it is also the division of Yùzhōu (豫州)."
On the day Dīngchǒu (丁丑),
the moon infringed upon Fáng (房).
The prognostication stated:
"Generals and prime ministers will have sorrow."
In the sixth month, on the day Jǐchǒu (己丑),
the moon infringed upon Mǎo (昴).
The prognostication was the same as above.
On the day Yǐwèi (乙未),
the moon infringed upon Wǔzhūhóu (五諸侯).
The prognostication was the same as above.
In the seventh month, on the day Rényín (壬寅),
the moon first appeared in the west,
infringing upon Zuǒjiǎo (左角).
The prognostication stated:
"A great general will die."
One interpretation said:
"There will be war in the world."
On the day Dīngwèi (丁未),
the moon infringed upon Jī (箕).
The prognostication stated:
"A general will die."
On the day Bǐngyín (丙寅),
Yínghuò (熒惑) infringed upon Yuè (鉞) star.
The prognostication stated:
"A high minister will be executed."
In the eighth month, on the day Xīnmǎo (辛卯),
the moon infringed upon Zuǒjiǎo (左角).
Tài Bái (太白) was seen in daylight,
in Nándǒu (南斗).
The moon infringed upon Yòu Zhífǎ (右執法).
All prognostication were the same as above.
In this year,
Sītú (司徒) Cài Mó (蔡謨) was dismissed and became a commoner.
In the seventh year, in the second month,
Tài Bái (太白) infringed upon Mǎo (昴).
The prognostication was the same as above.
In the third month, on the day Yǐmǎo (乙卯),
Yínghuò (熒惑) entered Yúguǐ (輿鬼),
infringing upon Jīshī (積尸).
The prognostication stated:
“Noble persons will have worries.”
In the fifth month, on the *yǐwèi* day,
Yínghuò (Mars) trespassed against Xuānyuán's (Regulus') great star.
The prognostication stated:
“The empress will have worries.”
Tàibái (Venus) entered the mouth of Bì (Hyades),
and trespassed against its left thigh.
The prognostication stated:
“Generals will suffer corresponding misfortunes.”
In the sixth month, on the *yǐhài* day,
the Moon trespassed against Jī (Sagittarius).
The prognostication stated:
“The state will have soldiers (war).”
On the *bǐngzǐ* day,
the Moon trespassed against Dǒu (Sagittarius).
On the *dīngchǒu* day,
Yínghuò (Mars) entered Tàiwēi (Leo),
and trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer.
In the eighth month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
Tàibái (Venus) trespassed against Xuānyuán (Leo).
On the *wùzǐ* day,
Tàibái (Venus) trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer.
All prognostication was the same as above.
In the seventh year,
Liú Xiǎn killed Shí Zhī and various generals and commanders.
Shāndōng was in great chaos,
with widespread disease and death.
In the eighth year, in the third month, on the *wùxū* day,
the Moon trespassed against Xuānyuán's (Regulus') great star.
On the *guǐchǒu* day,
the Moon entered Nándǒu (Southern Dipper),
and trespassed against the second star.
In the fifth month,
the Moon trespassed against the Xīn (Antares) star.
In the sixth month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
the Moon trespassed against Fáng (Scorpio).
In the seventh month, on the *rénzǐ* day,
Suìxīng (Jupiter) trespassed against the Jù star of Dōngjǐng (Gemini).
The prognostication stated:
“Internal strife and war will arise.”
In the eighth month, on the *wùxū* day,
Yínghuò (Mars) entered Yúguǐ (Cancer).
The prognostication stated:
“Loyal ministers will be executed.”
On the *bǐngchén* day,
Tàibái (Venus) entered Nándǒu (Southern Dipper),
and trespassed against the fourth star.
The prognostication stated:
“Generals will cause chaos.”
Another interpretation:
“The chancellor will be dismissed.”
In the ninth year, in the second month, on the *yǐsì* day,
the Moon entered Nándǒu (Southern Dipper),
and trespassed against the third star.
In the third month, on the *wùchén* day,
the Moon trespassed against Fáng (Scorpio).
In the eighth month,
Suìxīng (Jupiter) trespassed against the southeast star of Yúguǐ (Cancer).
The prognostication stated:
“War will arise.”
At this time,
the emperor was young and inexperienced,
the empress dowager ruled on his behalf,
the generals and ministers had discord,
and wars continually erupted.
Mùróng Jùn usurped the title of King of Yān,
and his campaigns of conquest were unceasing.
In the tenth year, in the first month, on the *yǐmǎo* day,
there was a lunar eclipse of Mǎo (Pleiades) stars.
The prognostication stated:
“Zhào and Wèi will have soldiers (war).”
On the *guǐyǒu* day,
Tiánxīng (Saturn) covered the Yuè (Axe) star.
The prognostication stated:
“Axes will be used (executions).”
In the second month, on the *jiǎshēn* day,
the Moon trespassed against the great star of Xīn (Antares).
The prognostication stated:
“The king will be displeased.”
In the seventh month, on the *gēngwǔ* day,
Tàibái (Venus) was visible during the day.
Calculated by the gnomon,
the disaster was in Qín and Zhèng.
In the ninth month, on the *xīnyǒu* day,
Tàibái (Venus) trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer.
At this time,
Huán Wēn acted arbitrarily,
and many court officials were coerced.
In the fourth month,
Huán Wēn attacked Fú Jiàn,
and defeated his Yáoliǔ army.
In the twelfth month,
Mùróng Kè attacked Qí.
In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the *xīnhài* day,
the Moon covered Xuānyuán (Leo).
The prognostication was the same as above.
In the fourth month, on the *gēngyín* day,
the Moon trespassed against the southern star of Niúxiù (Capricornus).
The prognostication stated:
“The state will have worries.”
In the eighth month, on the *jǐwèi* day,
Tàibái (Venus) trespassed against Tiānjiāng.
The prognostication stated:
“River crossings will be impassable.”
In the twelfth year, in the sixth month, on the *gēngzǐ* day,
Tàibái (Venus) was visible during the day,
in Dōngjǐng (Gemini).
The prognostication was as above.
On the *jǐwèi* day,
the Moon trespassed against the Yuè (Axe) star.
In the eighth month, on the *guǐyǒu* day,
the Moon covered the Jiàn star.
In the ninth month, on the *wùyín* day,
Yínghuò (Mars) entered Tàiwēi (Leo),
and trespassed against the Upper General star of the Western Fence.
In the eleventh month, on the *dīngchǒu* day,
Yínghuò (Mars) trespassed against the Upper Chancellor star of the Eastern Fence of Tàiwēi (Leo).
In the twelfth year, in the eleventh month,
Qí city fell,
Duàn Kān was captured,
and over three thousand people were killed.
In the third year of Yǒnghé,
the Xiānbēi invaded Hé and Jì.
In the first year of Shēngpíng,
Mùróng Jùn then occupied Línzhāng,
gaining full control of the lands of Yōu, Bìng, Qīng, and Jì.
The various generals along the river scattered and fled,
and the river crossings were cut off.
At this time, power was held by local lords,
and wars broke out everywhere.
In the fourth month, on the day Rénzǐ, of the first year of Shēngpíng,
Tàibái entered Yúguǐ.
On the day Dīnghài,
the Moon occulted the second star west of the southern shaft of Jǐng.
The prognostication said:
"There will be troops in Qín territory."
Another said:
"A general will die."
In the sixth month, on the day Wùxū,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Zhěn.
The prognostication was the same as above.
Zhěn is the celestial division of Chǔ.
On the day Rénzǐ,
the Moon trespassed against Bì.
The prognostication said:
"There will be border troops."
In the seventh month, on the day Xīnsì,
Yínghuò trespassed against Tiānjiāng.
The prognostication said:
"The river ford will be impassable."
In the eleventh month,
Suìxīng trespassed against Fáng.
The prognostication said:
"There will be disaster in Yùzhōu."
In the fifth month of that year,
Fú Jiān killed Fú Shēng and ascended the throne.
In the twelfth month,
Mùróng Jùn entered and garrisoned Yè.
In the eighth month of the second year,
Yùzhōu Cìshǐ Xiè Yì died.
In the second month, on the day Xīnmǎo, of the second year,
Tiánxīng trespassed against the great star of Xuānyuán.
The prognostication said:
"The human lord will be displeased by it."
On the day Jiǎwǔ,
the Moon trespassed against Dōngjǐng.
In the sixth month, on the day Xīnyǒu,
the Moon trespassed against Fáng.
In the tenth month, on the day Jǐwèi,
Tàibái trespassed against Kūxīng.
The prognostication said:
"There will be great weeping."
In the first month, on the day Rénchén, of the third year,
Yínghuò trespassed against Jiànbìxīng.
According to the prognostication, it said:
"The human lord will worry."
In the third month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
Yínghuò retrograded and trespassed against Gōuqín.
According to the prognostication:
"The king will be displeased by it."
In the sixth month,
Tàibái trespassed against Dōngjǐng.
In the seventh month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
Yínghuò trespassed against Tiānjiāng.
On the day Bǐngxū,
Tàibái trespassed against Yúguǐ.
The prognostication was entirely the same as above.
On the day Wùzǐ,
the Moon trespassed against the central great star of Qiānniú.
The prognostication said:
"Qiānniú
is the celestial general.
Trespassing against the central great star
means a general will die."
In the eighth month, on the day Dīngwèi,
Tàibái trespassed against the great star of Xuānyuán.
On the day Jiǎzǐ,
the Moon trespassed against the great star of Bì.
The prognostication said:
"There will be border troops."
Another said:
"The lower will trespass against the upper."
In the tenth month of the third year,
Zhūgě Yōu's naval forces entered the river
and were defeated.
Yùzhōu Cìshǐ Xiè Wàn entered Yǐng,
but his troops scattered and returned,
and Wàn was stripped of his title.
In the eleventh month,
Sītú Kuàijī Wáng, due to the defeat of the two garrisons of Xī Tán and Xiè Wàn,
requested to be demoted three ranks.
In the first month of the fourth year,
Mùróng Jùn died,
and his son Wěi succeeded him.
Mùróng Kè killed his Shàngshūlìng Yáng Wù and others.
In the first month, on the day Yǐhài, of the fourth year,
the Moon trespassed against the central great star of Qiānniú.
In the sixth month, on the day Xīnhài,
Chénxīng trespassed against Xuānyuán.
The prognostication said:
"The female ruler will worry."
On the day Jǐwèi,
Tàibái entered the right flank gate of Tàiwēi,
and exited through the Duānmén.
The prognostication said:
"The noble will lose power."
Another said:
"There will be troops."
It also said:
"Exiting the Duānmén
means ministers are not loyal."
In the eighth month, on the day Wùshēn,
Tàibái trespassed against Dī.
The prognostication said:
"The state will have worries."
On the day Bǐngchén,
Yínghuò trespassed against the upper general star of the western guard of Tàiwēi.
In the ninth month, on the day Rénwǔ,
Tàibái entered the mouth of the Nándòu,
and trespassed against the fourth star.
The prognostication said:
"There will be mourning,
a general amnesty,
and the world will receive titles and emoluments."
In the twelfth month, on the day Jiǎyín,
Yínghuò trespassed against Fáng.
On the day Bǐngyín,
Tàibái was seen in daylight.
On the day Gēngyín,
the Moon trespassed against Jiànbì.
The prognostication said:
"The human lord will be displeased by it."
In the first month, on the day Yǐsì, of the fifth year,
Tiánxīng retrograded,
and trespassed against Tàiwēi.
In the fifth month, on the day Rényín,
the Moon trespassed against Tàiwēi.
On the day Gēngxū,
the Moon trespassed against Jiànxīng.
The prognostication said:
"Ministers will conspire together."
At this time,
Yīn Hào was defeated,
and eventually exiled.
In the same month, on the day Xīnhài,
the Moon trespassed against the Qiānniú mansion.
The prognostication said:
"The state will have worries."
In the sixth month, on the day Guǐhài,
the Moon trespassed against the northeastern star of Dī.
The prognostication said:
"The great general will bear it."
Běi Zhōnglángjiàng Xī Tán died.
In the fifth month,
the Emperor passed away,
and Āidì ascended the throne,
granting a general amnesty,
and bestowing titles;
Empress Chǔ lost power.
In the seventh month,
Mùróng Kè attacked Jìzhōu Cìshǐ Lǚ Hù at Yěwáng,
and Hù fled to Xíngyáng.
At this time,
Huán Wēn, with a large army, was stationed at Wǎn;
hearing of Hù's defeat,
he then retreated.
In the sixth month, on the day Guǐyǒu, of the fifth year,
the Moon occulted the northeastern star of Dī.
The prognostication said:
"The Great General will bear it."
In the ninth month, on the day Yǐyǒu,
the Moon occulted Bì.
The prognostication said:
"There will be border troops."
In the tenth month, on the day Dīngwèi,
the Moon trespassed against the great star of Bì.
The prognostication said:
"The lower will trespass against the upper."
It also said:
"There will be border troops."
In the eighth month,
Fàn Wāng was deposed.
In the first year of Lónghé,
Mùróng Wěi sent a general to raid Héyīn.
In the seventh month, on the day Gēngxū, of the third year of Āidì's Xīngníng reign,
the Moon trespassed against Nándòu.
The prognostication said:
"The female ruler will worry."
Suìxīng trespassed against Yúguǐ.
The prognostication said:
"The human lord will worry."
In the tenth month,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Kàng.
The prognostication said:
"Kàng represents the imperial court;
there will be military calamities and mourning,
and ministers will become powerful."
In the fifth month of the next year,
Empress Yǔ passed away.
In the first month of the second year of Tàihé of Hǎixī,
Tàibái entered Mǎo.
In the fifth year,
Mùróng Wěi was annihilated by Fú Jiān,
who then occupied the four prefectures of Sī, Jì, Yōu, and Bìng.
In the intercalary month of the sixth year,
Yínghuò guarded the Duānmén of Tàiwēi.
The prognostication said:
"The Son of Heaven will lose his country."
It also said:
"Vassal lords and the three highest ministers conspire against their sovereign."
Another interpretation said:
"There will be a minister executed."
On the day Xīnmǎo,
the moon encroached upon the Dàxīng of Xīn.
The prognostication said:
"The king dislikes it."
In the eleventh month,
Huán Wēn deposed the Emperor,
and also requested the execution of Wǔlíng Wáng.
Jiǎnwén did not permit it,
so Wēn moved him to Xīn'ān.
All these were manifestations of a powerful minister.
On the day Xīnmǎo in the twelfth month of the first year of Xián'ān of Jiǎnwén,
Yínghuò retrograded into Tàiwēi.
In the third month of the second year, it still had not withdrawn.
The prognostication said:
"The country is not at peace,
there is sorrow."
At this time,
the Emperor was under duress from Huán Wēn.
On the day Dīngwèi in the fifth month of the second year,
Tàibái encroached upon Tiānguān.
The prognostication said:
"War will arise."
The form and color of Suìxīng were like Tàibái.
The prognostication said:
"Advancing and retreating in proper measure,
wickedness ceases;
changing color and disordered movement,
the ruler has no fortune.
Suìxīng in mid-summer should be small and dim,
this is its abnormality.
Also, it indicates a powerful minister."
In the sixth month,
Tàibái was visible during the day,
in Qīxīng.
On the day Yǐyǒu,
Tàibái encroached upon Yúguǐ.
The prognostication said:
"The country has sorrow."
In the seventh month,
the Emperor passed away.
Huán Wēn, with military might, seized power,
intending to execute Wáng Tǎnzhī and others,
pressuring them internally and externally.
Furthermore,
Yú Xī entered the capital city,
and Lú Sǒng entered the palace,
leading to their extermination.
On the day Wùshēn in the first month of the first year of Níngkāng of Xiàowǔ,
the moon occulted the Dàxīng of Xīn.
The prognostication said:
"The disaster is either not on the king,
or it is in Yùzhōu."
Another interpretation said:
"The ruler's mandate is displeased with it."
On the day Bǐngwǔ in the third month,
the moon occulted the fifth star of Nándǒu.
The prognostication said:
"A great minister worries,
there will be death."
Another interpretation said:
"A general will die."
In the seventh month,
Huán Wēn passed away.
On the day Guǐsì in the ninth month,
Yínghuò entered Tàiwēi.
At this time,
the empress dowager presided over the court,
and many state affairs were neglected.
On the day Jǐwèi in the intercalary month of the second year,
the moon occulted the southern star of Qiānniú.
The prognostication said:
"The Left General will die."
On the day Jiǎshēn in the twelfth month,
Tàibái was visible during the day,
in Dī.
Dī
is the corresponding region of Yǎnxī Zhōu.
On the day Bǐngwǔ in the fifth month of the third year,
the Northern Zhonglángjiàng Wáng Tǎnzhī passed away.
On the day Xīnmǎo in the sixth month of the third year,
Tàibái encroached upon Dōngjǐng.
The prognostication said:
"There is war in the Qín region."
On the day Wùshēn in the ninth month,
Yínghuò occulted the Zuǒ Zhífǎ.
The prognostication said:
"The law enforcer will die."
In the first year of Tàiyuán,
Fú Jiān defeated Liángzhōu.
In the tenth month of the second year,
Shàngshū Lìng Wáng Biāozhī passed away.
In the first year of Tàiyuán, in the fourth month, on the day of Bǐngxū,
Yínghuò trespassed upon the third star of Nándǒu.
On Bǐnshēn,
it again obscured the fourth star.
The prognostication stated:
"A great war will arise,
and the Central Plains will suffer famine."
Another interpretation said:
"There will be an amnesty."
In the eighth month, on Guǐyǒu,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Dī.
Dī
is the stellar field of Yǎnzhōu.
In the ninth month,
Yínghuò trespassed upon the Kūqì stars,
then entered Yǔlín.
The prognostication stated:
"The Son of Heaven will have a cause for weeping,
and the central army will rise."
In the eleventh month, on Jǐwèi,
the Moon obscured Dījiǎo.
[一一]The prognostication stated:
"There will be war in the world."
Another interpretation said:
"The state will have worries."
In the second year, in the second month,
Yínghuò guarded Yǔlín.
The prognostication stated:
"The forbidden armies will rise in great numbers."
In the ninth month, on Rénwǔ,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Jiǎo.
Jiǎo
is the stellar field of Yǎnzhōu.
In the fifth month of Shēngpíng first year,
there was a general amnesty.
In the eighth month of the third year,
the Qín people raided Fán, Dèng, Xiāngyáng, and Péngchéng.
In the second month of the fourth year,
Xiāngyáng fell,
and Zhū Xù was captured.
In the fourth month,
Wèixīng fell,
and the bandits gathered at Guǎnglíng and Sānhé,
numbering fifty to sixty thousand.
Thereupon, all armies were stationed at strategic points,
and the Administrator of Dānyáng garrisoned the capital.
In the sixth month,
the Inspector of Yǎnzhōu, Xiè Xuán, attacked the bandits
and greatly defeated them.
At this time,
both internal and external armies were engaged,
and there were successive years of famine.
In the eleventh month of the fourth year, on Dīngsì,
Tàibái trespassed upon the Kūxīng.
The prognostication stated:
"The Son of Heaven will have a cause for weeping."
In the seventh month of the fifth year, on Bǐngzǐ,
Chénxīng trespassed upon Xuānyuán.
The prognostication stated:
"A female ruler will be affected."
In the ninth month, on Guǐwèi,
Empress Wáng died.
In the ninth month of the sixth year, on Bǐngzǐ,
Tàibái was seen in daylight.
In the eleventh month of the seventh year,
Tàibái was again seen in daylight,
in Dǒu.
The prognostication stated:
"Wú will suffer military losses."
In the fourth month of the eighth year, on Jiǎzǐ,
Tàibái was again seen in daylight,
in Cān.
The prognostication stated:
"Wèi will suffer military losses."
In this month,
Huán Chōng campaigned in Miǎnhàn,
and Yáng Liàng attacked Shǔ,
both capturing cities and seizing territory.
In the eighth month,
Fú Jiān personally led an army,
claiming a million men.
In the ninth month,
he attacked and captured Shòuyáng.
In the tenth month,
Liú Láozhī defeated Fú Jiān's general Liáng Chéng,
beheaded him,
and killed or captured over ten thousand men.
Xiè Xuán and others again defeated Fú Jiān at Féishǔi,
beheading his brother Róng.
Jiān's vast army then collapsed and fled.
In the sixth month of the ninth year,
Empress Dowager Chǔ died.
In the eighth month,
Xiè Xuán moved his garrison to Péngchéng,
planning to pacify Zhōngzhōu.
In the seventh month of the ninth year, on Bǐngxū,
Tàibái was seen in daylight.
In the eleventh month, on Dīngsì,
it was again seen in daylight.
In the fourth month of the tenth year, on Yǐhài,
it was again seen in daylight in Bì and Mǎo.
The prognostication stated:
"The state of Wèi will suffer military losses."
At this time, Fú Jiān's vast army had collapsed and fled,
Zhào and Wèi were engaged in continuous warfare,
and Jiān was killed by Yáo Cháng.
In the third month of the eleventh year, on Wùshēn,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Dōngjǐng.
The prognostication stated:
"Qín will have war,
and its ministers will be strong."
In the sixth month, on Jiǎshēn,
it was again seen in daylight in Yúguǐ.
The prognostication stated:
"Qín will have war."
At this time, Wèi, Yáo Cháng, and Fú Dēng were continuously engaged in warfare,
campaigning against each other without cease.
On Jiǎwǔ,
Suìxīng was seen in daylight,
in Wèi.
The prognostication stated:
"Lǔ will have war,
and its ministers will be strong."
In the twelfth year,
Mùróng Chuí raided Dōng'ē,
Dié Liáo raided Héshàng,
Yáo Cháng falsely declared himself emperor in Āndìng,
Fú Dēng established himself in Lǒngshàng,
and Lǚ Guāng usurped the cool lands (Liángtǔ).
In the sixth month of the twelfth year, on Guǐmǎo,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Liǔ.
In the tenth month, on Gēngwǔ,
Tàibái was seen in daylight,
in Dǒu.
In the first month of the thirteenth year, on Bǐngxū,
it was again seen in daylight.
In the twelfth month,
Yínghuò was in Jiǎokàng,
its appearance and color fierce and intense.
The prognostication stated:
"If Yínghuò deviates from its normal course,
officials will abandon their laws,
and the feudal lords will throw their governance into disorder."
Thereafter,
Mùróng Chuí, Dié Liáo, Yáo Cháng, Fú Dēng, and Mùróng Yǒng all took up arms and vied for power.
In the first month of the fourteenth year,
a demonic bandit from Péngchéng again proclaimed himself in Huángqiū,
and Liú Láozhī defeated and exterminated him.
In the third month,
Zhāng Dào broke through Héxiāng,
[一二]besieged Tàishān,
and Xiàng Qīnzhī attacked and drove him away.
In this year,
Dié Liáo again attacked and captured Xíngyáng,
and encroached upon Chén and Xiàng.
At this time, government affairs were often fraught with abuses,
and the way of the ruler was in decline.
In the fourth month of the fourteenth year, on Yǐsì,
Tàibái was seen in daylight in Liǔ.
In the sixth month, on Xīnmǎo,
it was again seen in daylight in Yì.
In the ninth month, on Bǐngyín,
it was again seen in daylight in Zhěn.
In the twelfth month,
Yínghuò entered Yǔlín.
The prognostics were all the same as above.
In the fifteenth year,
Dié Liáo plundered Sī and Yǎn (provinces),
and the various armies repeatedly attacked him without success.
Mùróng Chuí also extended his control over Bìng, Jì, and other provinces.
In the seventh month,
there was a drought.
In the eighth month,
there were great floods in various commanderies,
and Yǎnzhōu also suffered from locusts.
In the ninth month of the fifteenth year, on Guǐwèi,
Yínghuò entered Tàiwēi.
In the tenth month,
Tàibái entered Yǔlín.
On the first day of the fourth month of the sixteenth year, Guǐmǎo,
Tàibái was seen in daylight.
In the eleventh month, on Guǐsì,
the Moon obscured the foremost star of Xīn.
The prognostication stated:
"The Crown Prince will have worries."
At this time,
the Crown Prince often suffered from a serious illness.
In the seventh month of the seventeenth year, on Dīngchǒu,
Tàibái was seen in daylight.
In the tenth month, on Dīngyǒu,
it was again seen in daylight.
In the sixth month of the eighteenth year,
it was again seen in daylight.
In the fifth month of the nineteenth year,
it was again seen in daylight in Liǔ.
In the sixth month, on Xīnyǒu,
It was also seen during the day in Yúguǐ.
In the ninth month,
it was again seen in Zhěn.
In the sixth month of the twentieth year,
Yínghuò entered Tiānqūn.
The divination said:
"There will be a great famine."
On the dìnghài day of the seventh month,
Tàibái was seen during the day in Tàiwēi.
The divination said:
"Tàibái entering Tàiwēi

Being seen during the day
forebodes war and death."
On the jǐsì day of the twelfth month,
the Moon encroached upon Jiànbì and Dōngxīxián.
The divination said:
"Jiànbì presides over the heart, abdomen, throat, and tongue,

On the rénshēn day of the second month of the twenty-first year,
Tàibái was seen during the day.
On the guǐmǎo day of the third month,
Tàibái was continuously seen during the day
in Yǔlín.
The divination said:
"There will be powerful ministers,
war and death,
and the central army will rise in rebellion."
In the third month,
Tàibái was seen during the day in Wèi.

"The central army will rise in rebellion."

Tàibái entered Tiānqūn.
The divination said:
"This forebodes famine."
In the sixth month,
Suìxīng encroached upon Kūqìxīng.
The divination said:
"There will be matters of weeping."
In the ninth month of this year,
the Emperor passed away.
In the first year of Lóng'ān,
Wáng Gōng and others raised troops to threaten the imperial court.
Thereupon, internal and external areas were put under strict alert,
and Wáng Guóbǎo was executed to appease them.
Also, for successive years there were floods and droughts,
the three regions were restless,
and the common people suffered famine.
On the guǐhài day of the first month of the first year of Ān Dì Lóng'ān,
Yínghuò encroached upon Kūqìxīng.
The divination said:
"There will be matters of weeping."
On the dīngchǒu day of the fourth month,
Tàibái was seen during the day

The divination said:
"Qín will have war and death."
In the sixth month,
Yáo Xìng attacked Luòyáng,
and Xī Huī dispatched troops to relieve it.
In winter, Yáo Cháng died,
and his son, LǖE, succeeded him.
Wèi Wáng Guī ascended the throne in Zhōngshān.
In the eighth month of that year,
Yínghuò guarded Jǐngyuè.
The divination said:
"Ministers will be executed."
On the wùchén day of the sixth month of the second year,
Shètí shifted its degree abnormally.
Suìxīng was seen during the day
in Wèi,
the division of Yǎnzhōu.
In the sixth month of this year,
Xī Huī dispatched Dèng Qǐfāng and others with ten thousand men to attack Mùróng Bǎo at Huátái,
[一三] but they were defeated and returned.
In the intercalary month,
Tàibái was seen during the day

On the dīngchǒu day,
the Moon encroached upon Dōngshàngxiàng.
On the xīnyǒu day of the fifth month of the third year,
the Moon again obscured Dōngshàngxiàng.
On the xīnwèi day,
Chénxīng encroached upon Xuānyuán Dàxīng.
The divinations were all the same as above.
In the ninth month of the second year,
Yǔ Kǎi and others raised troops,

In the sixth month of the third year,
Luòyáng fell to the invaders.
[一四] Huán Xuán defeated Jīng and Yōng Prefectures,

Sūn Ēn gathered followers and attacked and captured Kuàijī,

On the xīnyǒu day of the sixth month of the fourth year,
the Moon encroached upon Kūqìxīng.

Tàibái was seen during the day.

"The king will have worries."

Yínghuò encroached upon Shǎowēi,

"Hermits will be executed."
On the jiǎzǐ day of the tenth month,
the Moon encroached upon Dōngcìxiàng.
In the seventh month of that year,
Grand Empress Dowager Lǐ Shì passed away.
In the tenth month,
the demonic bandits greatly defeated Gāo Yǎzhī at Yúyáo,

In the fifth year,
Sūn Ēn attacked and invaded commanderies and counties,
killing administrators,
reaching Jīngkǒu,
and advancing to Púzhōu,
whereupon internal and external areas were put under strict alert.
Ēn dispatched a separate general to attack Guǎnglíng,

In the ninth month,
Huán Xuán's memorial arrived,
defying the imperial decree and being disrespectful.
In the tenth month,
Sīmǎ Yuánxiǎn greatly prepared a naval force,

In the first month of Yuánxīng first year,
Lú Xún proclaimed himself General Who Conquers Barbarians,

and briefly held the lands of Yǒngjiā and Jìn'ān.
In the second month,
the Emperor, in military attire, dispatched the western army.
In the third month,
Huán Xuán
captured the capital,
killed Sīmǎ Yuánxiǎn,
and exiled Grand Tutor, Prince Dàozǐ of Kuàijī.
In the first year of Yuánxīng, third month, on the day Wùzǐ,
Tàibái transgressed the Wǔzhūhóu,

In the second month, on the day Bǐngchén,

In the second month of this year, on the day Bǐngchén,

Empress Hé of Yǒng'ān passed away.
In the first year of Yìxī (義熙), in the third month, on the day Rénchén (壬辰),
